content:
incident-bot: Page fired: reserved-pool.delta - 95th latency exceeded threshold (>1.2s) for 5m
Hana K: ack — I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now
Akash R: I'm seeing queue depth jump on delta-reserved-01; errors 502/504 on embedding route
Jordan M: link: https://console.redwood.io/tenant/delta/reserved/metrics — 95p latency 1.8s, qdepth 320
Hana K: running `rictl tenant inspect delta --pool reserved` to confirm
Hana K: snippet of logs:
```
2026-03-14T10:02:11Z | tenant=delta | route=/v1/embeddings | status=502 | latency=2300ms
2026-03-14T10:02:13Z | tenant=delta | route=/v1/generate   | status=200 | latency=1100ms
```
Akash R: also high KV cache evictions, `kvcache.evictions` spiked — possible stale cache fallback
Hana K: attempting temporary burst scale: `rictl scale --tenant delta --pool reserved --add 2 gpus --mode burst`
infra-bot: autoscale job started: job_id=as-38291. expected nodes:+2 within 90s
Hana K: while scaling, enabling model fallback for embeddings: set tenant policy -> prefer=gpt-small-quant for /v1/embeddings
Jordan M: recommend rate-limiting non-critical routes: `rictl route update --tenant delta --route /v1/analytics --qps 10`
Hana K: applied throttling to /v1/analytics and /v1/debug routes
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Hana K — escalation paused
Akash R: verified kvcache metrics after throttle: eviction rate down 60%
Hana K: scaling finished, new nodes joined (reserved-03, reserved-04). 95p latency dropping
Hana K: current metrics: 95p=0.85s, error-rate=0.8% (was 6.2%). customer impact: embeddings degraded for ~7 minutes, estimated 3% of calls returned 502
Jordan M: flag for postmortem: investigate root cause of kvcache churn + capacity thresholding
Hana K: handing off to Akash for next 45m monitoring — leaving a small runbook:
- monitor qdepth and 95p in tenant dashboard
- keep model fallback active until eviction rate <5% for 5m
- if latency rises, increase burst by 1 GPU `rictl scale ... --add 1`
Akash R: taking over. thanks Hana. will update if anything else pops
Hana K: filing short incident note to #incidents and pinging account team for delta informing about brief degradation :wave:
pagerduty: Incident resolved (auto) — incident closed by Akash R
Hana K: leaving final note: mitigations applied=burst scale, throttling non-critical routes, model fallback; follow-up PM for quota/config tuning
